triples.subject: Ilya
triples.quote: Her father, a homeless, sickly drunkard, called Ilya, had lost everything and lived many years as a workman with some well-to-do tradespeople.

triples.subject: Ilya
triples.quote: Spiteful and diseased, Ilya used to beat Lizaveta inhumanly whenever she returned to him.

triples.subject: Grigory
triples.quote: At the time, Grigory stood up for his master vigorously. He provoked quarrels and altercations in defense of him and succeeded in bringing some people round to his side.

triples.subject: Pavel Fyodorovitch Smerdyakov
triples.quote: So this Smerdyakov became Fyodor Pavlovitch’s second servant, and was living in the lodge with Grigory and Marfa at the time our story begins.

triples.subject: Marfa
triples.quote: So Marfa brought up the child. He was christened Pavel, to which people were not slow in adding Fyodorovitch (son of Fyodor).

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: Then suddenly a terrible rumor was all over the town that this miscreant was no other than Fyodor Pavlovitch.
